mapper.select: SELECT id, app_id, api_name, display_name, description, icon_url, icon_gray_url, created_at, updated_at FROM game_achievement_schema WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY api_name ASC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO game_achievement_schema ( app_id, api_name, display_name, description, icon_url, icon_gray_url ) VALUES
(#{x.appId}, #{x.apiName}, #{x.displayName}, #{x.description}, #{x.iconUrl}, #{x.iconGrayUrl})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE display_name = VALUES(display_name), description = VALUES(description), icon_url = VALUES(icon_url), icon_gray_url = VALUES(icon_gray_url), updated_at = NOW()
